artworks.title: Tournament Executed in Florence for the Marriage of Grand Duke Ferdinand I
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an equestrian performance in a grand arena. The central portion of the image shows an oval enclosure surrounded by a tall, intricate structure with an elaborate entry gate. In the center of this oval space, there is a detailed depiction of a choreographed horse performance with numerous horses and riders. The upper and lower segments display various panels illustrating different formations and scenes related to the equestrian display. Flanking the central scene, there are two large horses richly decorated. The image captures the organized chaos and spectacle of the event being portrayed.

artworks.title: Parade with a Chariot Having the Form of a Ship
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This image shows a detailed drawing of a naval spectacle in a grand arena. The vast enclosed space resembles a coliseum or amphitheater filled with an audience watching the spectacle below. In the center is a large ship with sails, surrounded by figures arranged in formation. The drawing style features fine lines and intricate etching, showcasing the grand scale of the event. The background includes trees and structures, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Entrance of the Prince of Tuscany
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a public festivity or parade scene in a grand courtyard. The area is filled with figures, some on horseback and others on foot, engaging in a choreographed display or celebration. In the center stands a large statue of a figure holding a globe. Surrounding the courtyard are structures resembling palatial buildings, with ornate decorations and spectators observing. The background includes foliage and trees, with a sky depicted with horizontal lines. The scene is detailed with intricate linework typical of engravings.

artworks.title: The Prince of Tuscany, His Horse Troops and Carriages around Mount Atlas
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image captures a grand outdoor procession or event. The scene features an open-air ceremonial square surrounded by tall, decorated walls and crowded by onlookers. In the center, there is an ornate structure or stage adorned with statues and intricate carvings. The square is filled with numerous uniformed horse riders or guards forming lines or procession paths. A central feature is a grand, flame-topped chariot, possibly part of a parade or theatrical performance. Majestic architecture, including archways and statues, frames the scene, and large flags or banners extend from the walls' heights in the background.

artworks.title: The Banquet of the Piacevoli
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior gathering. The scene shows a large hall with many individuals dressed in formal attire. The room is decorated with drapery, chandeliers, paintings, and tapestries. The drawing depicts depth and grandeur, capturing a sense of historical significance. The detailed architecture and clothing suggest a Baroque influence.

artworks.title: Clovis and Clotilda
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper [restrike]
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: There is a drawing of decorative artwork surrounding a depiction of two figures on horseback. The drawing shows an ornate, baroque-style border encasing a scene within. At the top and bottom of the border, there are cherubic faces adorned with leaves and floral patterns. The central image captures a moment involving two figures riding a horse, with foliage and a castle-like structure in the background. The scene is detailed, showing the movement and texture of the horses and the flowing garments of the figures. The background scenery suggests a rolling landscape under a cloud-streaked sky. The artwork reflects the elaborate and expressive style characteristic of baroque artistry.

artworks.title: Death on the Battle Field
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a skeletal figure riding a horse through a chaotic battlefield scene. The figure wields a scythe as it rides a ghostly horse, while soldiers and horses clash below in dust and turmoil. The skeletal rider and horse dominate the scene above the chaos, creating an aura of doom and decay. The linework and shading enhance the theme of death overpowering life.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image features three figures in an etching style. The central figure is shown standing next to a donkey, holding a child. The child has closed eyes and short hair. The central figure wears a long garment. Another figure is sitting on the donkey. A large tree is on the left side, with hills and trees in the background.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman riding a donkey, holding an infant in her arms. A man stands beside the donkey, leading it. In the background are trees, mountains, and cherubic faces or angels in the clouds. The woman wears a headscarf and long garments, and a halo is above her head. The etching is detailed and has a textured background.

artworks.title: Standing Sailor Talking with a Seated Levantine
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The etching shows a scene of people gathered along a shoreline, with some close to the viewer possibly on a beach or a narrow strip of land. The composition features a low perspective with the horizon towards the middle. The sky is lightly indicated with sparse linear strokes suggesting clouds. The individuals are depicted with short brushstrokes, giving a sense of movement and texture to their clothing. The color palette is monochromatic with various gray tones. More people are seen in the background near what seems to be a tent or fabric structure, indicating a market or gathering spot. A faint tower or building is visible in the far background.

artworks.title: A Seated White Sailor and a Standing Black Sailor
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a shipyard scene. Two figures are seated on the left, one wrapped in detailed fabric, while another stands nearby. In the background, a ship is under construction with scaffolding and several figures working on the deck. The horizon is subtly visible aligned with the lower mast and dock work. The etching technique is evident in the fine line work and shading, capturing fabric texture and ship structure. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing intricate detailing and line work over color.

artworks.title: Hungarian Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a horse, positioned centrally within the frame. The person is seen in profile, turned sideways with one hand on the reins and the other hanging loosely by their side. The face of the individual appears stern, with distinct features such as a pronounced nose and a full beard. They wear a large, furry hat that complements the thick coat which covers their body. The person is not adorned with any visible jewelry but carries a quiver of arrows slung across their back. The scene features other figures on horseback in the background, set against a sparse landscape with faintly sketched sky. Shadows beneath the horses suggest the source of light is above, casting a natural outdoor illumination over the scene.

artworks.title: Polish Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mounted soldiers in a landscape. The scene features several soldiers on horseback, dressed in historical military attire. They are positioned in various stances, some with swords drawn or held upright. At the center foreground, a soldier with a sword on his back is seen mounted on a horse, facing away from the viewer and surveying the landscape ahead. The background displays an expansive sky above a horizon filled with distant hills or mountains, adding a sense of depth to the composition. The circular framing of the drawing channels focus towards the interaction among the figures and the surrounding environment. The style of the drawing gives it a classical and detailed appearance, reminiscent of traditional prints or etchings often used to depict historical or military themes.

artworks.title: Two Polish Cavaliers
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several horses with riders. The drawing depicts a circular composition showing two riders in the foreground, seated on strong horses. The illustration includes detailed features of the horses' faces and the riders' clothing, portraying a sense of movement and historical attire. In the background, faint outlines suggest additional horses and riders, enhancing the depth of the image. The linear engraving style focuses on texture and shading, creating a cohesive narrative within the circular frame.

artworks.title: Hungarian Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The individual is seated upright on the horse, facing slightly to the left, with their right arm resting on the horse's reins. The person has distinct features with a round face and curly hair under a hat with a large feather. They are wearing a textured coat with ornate details and fitted pants. The background shows a slightly barren landscape with clouds in the sky. Two other figures on horseback are in the scene. One is riding to the left, while the other appears at rest or in conversation. The image is framed in an oval shape.

artworks.title: A Black Horseman
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows an individual mounted on a horse, facing right. The person is sitting upright on the horse, head turned slightly to the left. They have distinct facial features and wear a headdress with long feathers. The clothing is elaborate with draped fabric and visible patterns. Around them are other riders on the left and a standing figure on the right, dressed in layered garments. The horse is decorated with ornamental features around its head. The background includes architectural structures and open sky, suggesting an outdoor environment.

artworks.title: Polish Hussar
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: This image depicts a person seated on a horse. The individual is in a side profile, positioned on the horse with one hand holding the reins. The person has distinct facial features and is wearing ornate clothing and a hat with feathers. The horse is also adorned with decorative elements. In the background, there are other figures and horses in a serene landscape. The artwork features detailed lines and shading to enhance the depth of the scene.

artworks.title: Hungarian Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse, with other figures in the background. The person is dressed in elaborate attire appropriate for riding, including armor or heavy clothing. The horse has well-defined muscles and decorative harness. The background features other figures on foot and horseback, set in a flat landscape under a cloudy sky. The scene is enclosed in an oval frame.

artworks.title: Polish Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting upright on a galloping horse. The person wears a hat with a plume, a long robe with a fur-like texture, and holds a bow in their right hand. Other figures on horseback and standing, a stone structure, and a cloudy sky are visible in the background.

artworks.title: A Black Horseman
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The person holds a spear and looks to the left. They wear a turban with a feather, a fur-trimmed cloak, patterned garments, and a belt with attached items. The horse is in mid-step, with a bridle and a feather in its mane. The background features multiple figures on horseback and foot, a caravan of wagons, and a large tent-like structure under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Moorish Cavalier
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person mounted on a horse in a side profile. The person is wearing traditional attire with flowing garments, holding the reigns with their left arm bent. They have long hair with a feather or plume, carry a bow and quiver, and are seen alongside the detailed horse. The background consists of various figures, animals, structures, mountains, and a cloudy sky. The scene is enclosed within an oval border.

artworks.title: Satyrs and Faun
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image is a circular engraving showing satyrs and other figures in a wooded setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a view of the figures and the landscape. The horizon is not visible, with tree tops dominating the top, and a sky filled with soft, linear clouds created with horizontal brushstrokes. Various figures, including mythological satyrs, interact amidst lush vegetation. Trees in the background add depth with intricate, swirling lines. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly in shades of brown and sepia, accentuating the detailing and shading techniques.

artworks.title: Cow and Young Shepherd at a Fountain
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The observer's viewpoint is slightly below the scene, emphasizing the cow and other subjects in the middle area. The horizon is positioned low, with a hint of a landscape stretching into the distance. Beyond the central subjects, a faint outline of a building amidst trees breaks the horizon line. The engraving lines capture textures and shadows with precision. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from brown to gray. Closest to us, a cow stands beside a woman and a dog. Trees provide a canopy, with branches extending across the top of the image, and various elements fade into the background.

artworks.title: Peasant Seated on a Horse with Cows, Sheep, and Goats
artworks.creditLine: Transferred from The Library of Congress
artworks.description: The image provides a slightly elevated viewpoint of a landscape. The horizon is high, separating the sky from the land. A range of hills can be seen on the horizon, along with subtle structures or ruins in the distance. The etching showcases detailed rendering, especially in the clothing of a figure and the fur of animals. The color palette is monochromatic, using brown and sepia tones. In the foreground, a group of cattle, a human figure, and smaller animals are moving to the right. Delicate clouds are etched in the sky.
